timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is John Bonanno and I'm an orthopedic surgeon specializing in hip and knee replacement
surgery.
I grew up here in Salinas, California and graduated from Palma High School.
I primarily treat patients with hip and knee arthritis and together we develop a treatment
plan to improve their pain, function, and quality of life.
I credit my mom for inspiring me to become a doctor.
She's actually a nurse here at Salinas Valley Health and I grew up visiting her and volunteering
at the hospital.
My first introduction orthopedics was in high school when I tore my ACL and underwent a
surgery that allowed me to return to sports and even go on to become the starting field
goal kicker at the University of Arizona.
During my residency at Stanford, I rotated through a number of sub-specialties and quickly
realized that joint replacement surgery was my calling.
The most rewarding aspect of my specialty is the meaningful impact it can have on patient
slides.
When I first meet patients, they are often in pain and have limitations in their function
and activities.
I love being able to help them regain their mobility and stay active, which not only can
improve their physical health but their mental health as well.
One thing I love about my specialty is the potential for continued innovation.
During my training, I was fortunate to work with leaders in the field who are not only
researching but also adopting the latest computer navigation and robotic technology.
Based on this experience, I am introducing a new hit navigation system here at Salinas
Valley Health that can improve component placement during surgery.
Outside of medicine, I enjoy spending time with my family who still lives in the area.
I also enjoy going on hikes in the parks with my wife Adalina and dog Marley.
I am passionate about fitness and enjoy going to the gym and doing yoga to stay active.
I am excited and grateful to return home to the Salinas Valley to help serve patients
in this community.
I am currently accepting new patients.

youtube_description:
John Bonano, MD, grew up in Salinas, played football, graduated from Palma High School and spent time volunteering at Salinas Valley Health. 
Dr. Bonano is an orthopedic surgeon specializing in hip and knee replacement surgeries. He is now back in his hometown treating patients at Salinas Valley Health Orthopedics. He is accepting new patients.

To schedule an appointment with Dr. Bonano, call 831-757-3041.
